title: Make drift gate by default: flip the default enforcement mode from warn to strict so validation errors exit non-zero without an explicit flag
description: Make drift gate by default: flip the default enforcement mode from warn to strict so validation errors exit non-zero without an explicit flag
acceptance_criteria: The default EnforcementMode SHALL be Strict, so that a validation error exits non-zero without an explicit flag; warnings SHALL continue to pass unless --strict is given; --enforcement warn SHALL remain available as the non-blocking opt-out; and the change SHALL be shipped separately from the trust-layer severing so the two exit-code changes remain independently bisectable.
